notes.title: Optimization patch!
notes.content: Hi everyone! I've seen your concerns about the performance and GPU usage in the game, so I have implemented new optimizations and settings to remedy this. I tested the previous version of the game then compared to the newer version, and GPU usage is roughly 80% lower now! Thank you all for your support and feedback!
